values.content:
You are generating a 15-frame transformation sequence for an AI image-editing model that edits images frame-by-frame.

The goal is to restore an old, damaged vehicle into a fully clean, factory-new vehicle through gradual, realistic edits.

The vehicle type is chosen randomly but MUST remain the SAME throughout all frames:

Land: car, motorcycle, bus, truck, jeep
Sea: boat, yacht, fishing vessel
Air: airplane, helicopter, small aircraft

────────────────────────
CRITICAL CONSISTENCY RULES (ABSOLUTE — MUST FOLLOW)
────────────────────────

- The vehicle’s position, scale, orientation, proportions, and alignment MUST remain EXACTLY the same in all frames.
- The vehicle MUST stay fixed in place from start to finish.
- The camera angle, camera distance, lens perspective, and framing MUST NOT change.
- The background, environment, location, ground, sky, water, and surroundings MUST remain unchanged.
- NO cropping, zooming, reframing, tilting, warping, or perspective correction.
- ONLY the vehicle itself may be edited.
- If a requested change would require camera movement or background change, DO NOT perform that change.

────────────────────────
MATERIAL CONTINUITY RULE (MANDATORY)
────────────────────────

- Any vehicle part removed in any frame MUST be restored or replaced in a later frame.
- Replacement parts must:
  • Match the original vehicle design
  • Match original dimensions and placement
  • Appear factory-correct, clean, and new
- No vehicle component may remain missing by Frame 15.

────────────────────────
FRAME 1 — IMAGE GENERATION ONLY
────────────────────────

Frame 1 MUST be a complete image-generation prompt.
It must NOT be an edit instruction.

Frame 1 must fully describe the deteriorated vehicle scene, including:
- Exact vehicle type and model style
- Fixed environment and location
- Camera angle, distance, and viewpoint
- Lighting conditions
- Visible damage: rust, corrosion, dents, broken parts, cracked glass, faded paint, dirt, wear
- Surface textures and materials
- The vehicle must already be centered and positioned EXACTLY as it will remain in all frames

For Frame 1:
- "generate_prompt" MUST be filled
- "edit_instruction" MUST be an empty string ""

────────────────────────
FRAMES 2–15 — EDIT INSTRUCTIONS ONLY
────────────────────────

Frames 2–15 MUST be image EDIT instructions only.

- Do NOT generate a new image
- Do NOT describe or modify the environment
- Do NOT mention camera, background, or framing
- Edits must be localized ONLY to vehicle parts
- All edits must build upon the previous frame’s result
- Changes must be gradual, realistic, and incremental
- The vehicle type MUST remain identical across all frames

────────────────────────
RESTORATION PROCESS (STRICT ORDER — DO NOT CHANGE)
────────────────────────

Frame 2: Surface cleaning and debris removal
- Remove loose dirt, dust, mud, moss, and grime from visible vehicle surfaces
- Reveal existing damage without repairing it

Frame 3: Deep cleaning to expose true condition
- Remove embedded grime, oil residue, and oxidation film
- Clean glass, trim, and metal while keeping wear visible

Frame 4: Rust reduction and corrosion treatment (early stage)
- Reduce surface rust and flaking corrosion
- Stabilize exposed metal without fully restoring it

Frame 5: Rust treatment continuation
- Further reduce corrosion depth
- Smooth treated areas while preserving age marks

Frame 6: Remove old or unusable vehicle parts
- Remove broken, cracked, or severely damaged components
- Do NOT replace parts yet

Frame 7: Paint preparation and surface correction
- Strip peeling paint
- Smooth repaired metal and panels
- Prepare surfaces for repainting

Frame 8: Add new mechanical components
- Restore or replace essential mechanical elements visible on the vehicle
- Keep factory-correct placement and proportions

Frame 9: Reinstall removed parts with clean, new replacements
- Reattach previously removed components
- Parts must look new, clean, and original to the vehicle

Frame 10: Repair and restore lighting components
- Restore headlights, taillights, indicators, and lenses
- Ensure clarity and correct alignment

Frame 11: Add new tires and restore wheels
- Replace worn or damaged tires
- Clean and restore rims while keeping correct size and style

Frame 12: Final paint application (base coat)
- Apply fresh, even paint across the vehicle
- Maintain realistic reflections and material behavior

Frame 13: Paint refinement and finish correction
- Improve paint smoothness and consistency
- Subtle reflection enhancement only

Frame 14: Final detailing
- Polish paint
- Clean trim, chrome, seals, and fine details

Frame 15: Factory-new final appearance
- Vehicle must appear fully restored, clean, and modern
- Position, perspective, scale, and environment MUST remain IDENTICAL to Frame 1

────────────────────────
OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT — JSON ONLY)
────────────────────────

Return a JSON array only:

[
  {
    "frame": number,
    "step_name": "",
    "description": "",
    "generate_prompt": "",
    "edit_instruction": ""
  }
]

RULES:
- Frame 1 → generate_prompt filled, edit_instruction empty
- Frames 2–15 → edit_instruction filled, generate_prompt empty
- No camera movement
- No background change
- No perspective shift
- No sudden visual jumps
- Final frame must perfectly align with Frame 1
